notes.title: Watch Party is now Toybox!
notes.content:
[h2]An update from the Developers[/h2] 
When developing Watch Party, we wanted to allow players to watch online videos, listen to online music, share their screens, and be able to play mini-games together.

As such, we've decided to pivot slightly, and focus more on the aspect of mini-games and playing with friends. Rest assured, the core functionality of Watch Party will remain in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667425/00649edfdaac76a22ba29d0d19740b32b4bd0e64.gif[/img]

[h2]What is the near future for Toybox?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Collect thousands of items across hundreds of packs
[*] Daily login bonuses (Free packs, in-game currencies, etc)
[*] Display favorite items you've collected via shelves
[*] Invite friends over to hang out
[*] Watch videos in sync from YouTube
[*] Play mini-games solo or online
[*] Host public and private lobbies
[*] Stats, leaderboards, and achievements.
[*] In-game currencies
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667425/d5a713e9d120583b3d0704447d2b277b4dc4ed3b.gif[/img]

[h2]What is planned for Toybox?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Wide range of customizations for your room
[*] Steam Workshop: build & share maps for mini-games 
[*] FREE content updates (from environments to mini-games)
[*] Player Characters, Character Customization.
[*] DLC: Paid additional content & promotional packs
[*] Endless possibilities, much more to come!
[/list]


[h2]Community-Driven Content[/h2]
We plan to have various events to allow our community to plan, name, and vote on items that are put into the game. Player input and opinion is HIGHLY valued during the development process.

If you are an aspiring artist, 3D modeler, or content creator and would like to see your items in-game as an exclusive set, we would love for you to reach out to us!

If you have any other comments, questions, or ideas, feel free to join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/kdqdr9Y2UE]Official Toybox Discord[/url] where we often livestream the Toybox development process.


Have a great day, we look forward to collecting with your in the future!

Thank you, 
WeebMedia Development Team
